name: sales
description: Run outbound from your Second Brain, from inside Claude Code or Second Brain Studio: generate leads (your brain's warm ties and lost deals first, then companies on the public web with a reason to buy now, per market, with a coverage gate), research the buying team, run multi-step sequences, send email from your own mailbox and social steps in your own browser within your caps, work the replies and book the meetings — tracked as an indexed layer of your brain. No bought data, no tracking.

network.why: Lead generation reads public pages (company sites, careers boards, news, directories, registries, public threads) and LinkedIn's public no-login job search; email is sent and read through the seller's OWN mailbox (SMTP/IMAP); social steps and contact forms run in the seller's own signed-in Chrome; meetings use the seller's calendar connector. No data broker, no enrichment API, no tracking pixel. The Second Brain Link engine itself stays zero-network; this plugin is a separate distribution surface and declares its access here.
endpoints: public company, news, directory, event and registry pages reached by WebSearch / WebFetch
www.linkedin.com/jobs-guest (public, no-login job search — read only, paced, capped)
public careers-board APIs: boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.lever.co, api.ashbyhq.com, api.smartrecruiters.com, *.recruitee.com, *.jobs.personio.de, *.teamtailor.com, *.myworkdayjobs.com
the seller's own SMTP and IMAP servers (mail.py — sends only after send_guard.py allows it)
linkedin.com, x.com, web.whatsapp.com and company contact forms through the Chrome integration, in the seller's own session (opt-in for sending)
the Google Calendar connector — free/busy and event creation for booked meetings
